distance_arms.A: mu~Normal(mu_ext,sigma_ext); H0=73.24 km/s/Mpc, Om0=.28, flat LCDM; retain grey deltaM~N(0,.088^2)
distance_arms.B: independent mu~Uniform(20,50)mag for every SN, retain same grey deltaM; no redshift-conditioned amplitude prior
distance_arms.B_measure: Integrate D with the exact convolution of Uniform(mu) and Normal(deltaM); never flat a
distance_arms.frame_gate: Separate zHEL spectral/time transform from corrected zHD external distance. Freeze exact mu_ext/error vectors after preprocessing closure.

reference-spectrum calibration closure<1mmag; preserve any known source offsets rather than rescale to fit
